nodes.label: Gate 10 Quality CI Workflow
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow enforcing no-polling architecture on every push/PR to refraccion/main. Five jobs: backend (PHP 8.2 + SQLite + Redis on 6399), frontend (Vitest + build + static no-polling AST gate), frontend-responsive-e2e-mocked (Playwright against mocked Vite), ingestion (Python 3.12 pytest), architecture (file-existence assertions for retired relay files and CDC config presence).
nodes.rationale: The CI enforcement of the zero-polling architecture. Verifies retired relay files are absent, CDC components exist, and no product-state polling constructs exist in tracked frontend source.
